vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At the fix parent 5afbb3ea8e6319ec3630f5c5a6958ee72a1b61bf, PublicKey::verify() passes signature.data() to ecdsa_verify_digest without a length gate; trezor-crypto/crypto/ecdsa.c reads sig and sig+32 with no length parameter, while the CURVE25519 arm directly indexes signature[63]. The disclosure PoC supplies a 10-byte SECP256k1 signature. CVE-2025-66692 is PUBLISHED, NVD is Analyzed/CWE-126, and GHSA-6qpj-whq8-wr7j is not withdrawn.

atomic_bic.evidence: git log -L --reverse shows d7290d43c14a23a704211ca80d00d4e2a2b4323e creating src/PublicKey.cpp from /dev/null with the unguarded ecdsa_verify_digest call. Later commits only refactor, revert, or add further curve arms; none precedes this first-write. Although the root commit is a repository import, it is the smallest surviving public object and no finer public member is reconstructable, satisfying the protocol's root-object exception.
